messages:
🎉 Barcelona · Mon 16 Nov
Renfe/Rodalies strike all day Tue 17 Nov: reduced commuter and long-distance trains, so plan day trips and airport trains around it.

TODAY · Mon 16 Nov

1. Tapantoni — Sant Antoni tapas route
🕘 Mon 16 Nov · hours not stated · 📍 Participating bars across the Sant Antoni neighbourhood
📊 Featured in @planesenbarcelona's weekend round-up (1,356 likes) · runs 13–29 Nov
💶 Tapa + drink €3.80
💬 Neighbourhood-wide tapas crawl: hop between Sant Antoni bars with a tapa and a drink at each. Easy with a group and no booking needed.
https://www.tapantoni.com/

2. Language Exchange & Board Games + Pool & Darts & JAMBOREE DISCO (FREE)
🕘 Tonight 19:00 → 06:00 · 📍 La Pecera del Pool
📊 50 going on Meetup (limit 150) · group has 49,922 members · also on Eventbrite
💶 Free
💬 The big international Monday social: language exchange, board games, pool and darts, then free entry to Jamboree for whoever keeps going.
https://www.meetup.com/language-exchange-barcelona-meetup/events/316811212/

3. NOMAD RUN ★ 6KM with Entrepreneurs & Digital Nomads feat. La Fabrica &Co ROOFTOP
🕘 Tonight 19:00 → 21:00 · 📍 La Fabrica & Co
📊 21 going on Meetup · group has 15,675 members · also on Eventbrite
💶 Free
💬 A 6 km run with the nomad and founder crowd that ends with drinks on a rooftop. Good way to meet tech people without a networking format.
https://www.meetup.com/barcelona-digital-nomads-community/events/316897801/

4. Doun Doun Mondays feat. Marga Mbande
🕘 Tonight 21:00 → 01:00 · 📍 Sidecar
📊 no public headcount (DICE doesn't publish one)
💶 €12
💬 Live afrobeat with a seven-piece band and a guest singer in a small Gothic Quarter basement club, DJ before and after.
https://dice.fm/event/yoqdxp-doun-doun-mondays-feat-marga-mbande-16th-nov-sidecar-barcelona-tickets

5. Shitty Mic
🕘 Tonight 21:00 → 23:00 · 📍 The Clubhouse: Laietana & Nikki's, Ciutat Vella
📊 organiser has 1,919 followers on Eventbrite
💶 Free
💬 Free English-language open mic where being bad is the point. A low-stakes laugh in the centre before or instead of a late night.
https://www.eventbrite.es/e/shitty-mic-tickets-1985380643951

TOMORROW · Tue 17 Nov

1. Barça vs Paris Basketball — EuroLeague
🕘 Tue 20:30 · 📍 Palau Blaugrana
📊 EuroLeague Matchday 12, on FC Barcelona's and Paris Basketball's official schedules
💶 Check the club ticket page
💬 Top-level European basketball in Barça's home arena, loud and close to the court. Check ticket availability first, as some EuroLeague nights are members-only.
https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/club/club-schedule

2. Ed Maverick
🕘 Tue 21:00 → 23:45 · 📍 Razzmatazz
📊 no public headcount (DICE doesn't publish one)
💶 €39.80
💬 Mexican singer-songwriter with a huge young Latin following playing Razzmatazz's main room. The biggest concert in town on Tuesday.
https://dice.fm/event/nvx5vq-ed-maverick-17th-nov-razzmatazz-barcelona-tickets

3. Weekly Barcelona Digital Nomads & Entrepreneurs Networking Meetup
🕘 Tue 19:00 → 22:00 · 📍 TBA
📊 59 going on Meetup · group has 15,675 members
💶 Free to RSVP
💬 The weekly nomads and entrepreneurs meetup, the largest regular tech-adjacent social in the city. Venue is announced on the event page.
https://www.meetup.com/barcelona-digital-nomads-community/events/317282972/

4. Moods at Noxe (26th floor W Barcelona)
🕘 Tue 22:00 → 02:00 · 📍 Noxe Barcelona
📊 33 interested on RA · also on DICE, Eventbrite, Xceed
💶 Free guest list
💬 House music on the 26th floor of the W hotel with the city below. Free guest list, dressy door, so sign up ahead and skip the trainers.
https://ra.co/events/2569424

5. Tapantoni — Sant Antoni tapas route
🕘 Tue 17 Nov · hours not stated · 📍 Participating bars across the Sant Antoni neighbourhood
📊 Featured in @planesenbarcelona's weekend round-up (1,356 likes) · runs 13–29 Nov
💶 Tapa + drink €3.80
💬 Still on if you skip it Monday: a cheap tapas crawl before the game or a gig. At least one bar (Piñata Cantina) sits out Tuesdays.
https://www.tapantoni.com/

Scanned: Meetup 215 · RA 14 · DICE 6 · Xceed 11 · Eventbrite 111 · Luma 3 · Instagram 24 posts + 12 stories.
